answer: The whisper counter is kept in cipher and wander makes public each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1980 identities would post 4832 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
